purpose: development-data check of aligned target discrimination by channel set; nothing frozen, no continuous scan

fixed_features.fixed_pz_p300: Pz mean amplitude 0.3-0.6 s after onset, baseline-corrected; positive = target-like
fixed_features.fixed_c4_minus_c3: C4 minus C3 mean amplitude 0.2-0.8 s after onset; tests response-hand lateralization

rule.statement: midline bins or a fixed feature reach evaluation AUROC >= 0.70 in at least 7 of 12 sessions
